name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap is a Codex Plugin Agent that helps you find products that fit, compare offers, and check for useful deals. Start with a description, a product link, or a photo. Exact matches and similar alternatives are kept distinct, with differences explained rather than hidden. Cards show the verified item price, available Coupon evidence, selected specifications, stock information and merchant evidence. Without a verified item price, a lead is not shown as a product card; missing shipping or tax alone does not remove a priced card. Highly rated products can appear alongside reviewed merchants when they meet your requirements, but product ratings do not independently verify merchants or create a best-buy recommendation. Product and merchant ratings are labeled separately; merchant-rating admission still needs its own source and threshold. Compare two to four selected cards, or inspect one product's exact options without searching its title again. Prices and selections remain bound to their original results. Confirmed Coupon savings may inform an equal-fit price comparison; unconfirmed promotions and affiliate commission never decide the recommendation. User-authorized Chrome is a bounded fallback, not a way around a refusal. Any supported anonymous-cart quote requires a current explicit authorization; checkout determines eligibility, shipping, tax and final totals. FindCheap never completes checkout, purchases or pays. Native Codex permission prompts, real shopping acceptance and independent visual accuracy still need verification. Expect clear choices, honest gaps and one useful next step, not a promise of the lowest price everywhere.
defaultPrompt: Search products + current requirements. Keep required host announcements; no optional progress. Preserve card limitations.
